einzeiler: A deep dive into Coyote vs. Acme, alongside discussions on recent film news and releases.
kurzfassung: The hosts review the long-awaited Coyote vs. Acme, exploring how it brilliantly blends classic animation with live-action comedy. They also discuss recent cinematic releases like The Dog Stars and Buddy, alongside reflections on cultural icons who recently passed away. Additionally, they cover new movie announcements including a sequel to Days of Thunder.
stichpunkte: Discussion of recent industry losses, including Tim Curry, Peter Cullen, and Dolly Parton.
Announcement and skepticism regarding the upcoming action sequel Days of Thunder 2 starring Tom Cruise.
Review of Ridley Scott's post-apocalyptic drama The Dog Stars.
Review of the satirical dark-comedy children's show parody Buddy, directed by Casper Kelly.
Revisiting David Koepp's 1996 thriller The Trigger Effect.
Detailed review and spoiler discussion of the rescued feature Coyote vs. Acme.

clips.text: Peter Cullen single-handedly elevated the quality of Michael Bay's Transformers films by a significant margin just through his vocal presence.

clips.text: The narrative undergoes a completely jarring transformation during its final stretch into an entirely different genre without proper buildup.
Despite its flaws, the feature embraces an old-school, highly optimistic perspective on human nature that feels refreshing.

beschreibung:
David, Devindra, and Jeff remember some Hollywood icons who have recently passed, look up to the post-apocalyptic skies with The Dog Stars, and go behind the mask with Buddy. Then they head to court to render their verdict on the long awaited Coyote vs. Acme.
